description: A head of capital markets must decide whether to launch a tender offer for part of the bank's outstanding bonds and finalize the offer cap, price, liquidity reserve, disclosure timing, and offer window, with input from treasury risk, legal, and investor relations.

shared_context.S1: The bank has $30,000,000 of outstanding subordinated bonds, and the capital markets team has proposed repurchasing up to $18,000,000 through a tender offer.
shared_context.S2: The draft proposal assumes a tender price at par and does not specify a final cash reserve, disclosure lead time, or offer-window length.
shared_context.S3: Elena has authority to make the binding decision on whether and how to launch the tender offer.
shared_context.S4: As a routine pre-launch step, Elena holds a round-robin review with treasury risk, legal, and investor relations before approving the transaction.

PF1.text: Malik confirmed in this morning's liquidity review that $24,000,000 is available for the transaction, but treasury policy requires retaining a $10,000,000 unrestricted cash reserve after settlement. Therefore the tender cap must be set at exactly $14,000,000. That is the required cap value, not merely a ceiling, and it must not be adjusted downward for a cost buffer; he has not yet updated the capital-markets worksheet.

PF2.text: Joanna found in the current bond indenture while reviewing the file this week that the tender must remain open for exactly 10 business days and the offer document must be distributed at least 2 business days before launch; these terms are not yet in the draft timetable.

PF3.text: Victor received confirmation from the bank's largest institutional holder yesterday that it will tender its $8,000,000 position only at a price of 9,925 basis points per $100 of principal, and he has not yet added that call note to the transaction file.

acceptance_conditions: The tender offer must be launched with a maximum tender cap of exactly $14,000,000.
The settlement must retain exactly $10,000,000 of unrestricted cash.
The offer price must be exactly 9,925 basis points per $100 of principal.
The offer must remain open for exactly 10 business days.
The offer document must be distributed exactly 2 business days before launch.
The settlement must include a commitment documenting the liquidity capacity and cash reserve.
The settlement must include a commitment documenting both indenture timing requirements.
The settlement must include a commitment documenting the institutional holder's tender price.

content_checks.C7: any(('10,000,000' in c['detail'] or '10 million' in c['detail'] or '10M' in c['detail']) and ('reserve' in c['detail'] or 'cash reserve' in c['detail']) and ('14,000,000' in c['detail'] or '14 million' in c['detail'] or '14M' in c['detail'] or 'capacity' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(('10 business day' in c['detail'] or '10-business-day' in c['detail']) and ('2 business day' in c['detail'] or '2-business-day' in c['detail'] or '2-day' in c['detail'] or '2 day' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any(('99.25' in c['detail'] or '9,925' in c['detail']) and ('call note' in c['detail'] or 'transaction file' in c['detail'] or 'price' in c['detail'] or 'institutional holder' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The draft proposes an $18,000,000 repurchase with no reserve; PF1 changes tender_cap_usd to exactly $14,000,000 rather than a lower discretionary amount, changes cash_reserve_after_settlement_usd to exactly $10,000,000, and requires a commitment recording both figures.
The draft has no settled timetable; PF2 changes offer_open_days to exactly 10, disclosure_lead_days to exactly 2, and requires a commitment recording both indenture timing requirements.

The draft assumes a price at par without a confirmed investor condition; PF3 changes offer_price_basis_points_per_100 to exactly 9,925 and requires a commitment recording the institutional holder's price signal.
